name: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot
summary: Near Northshire Abbey, an Alliance bounty calls recruits to hunt Garrick Padfoot by the vineyards. The notorious thief and his gang threaten the valley's farmers and merchants.

sections.title: A Plague on the Valley
sections.body: Northshire Valley offered a safe place to train recruits and tend its sacred vineyards. But as order falters across Elwynn, thieves have reached the valley. Garrick Padfoot, a cutthroat, quickly rose to lead them. For weeks, he and his gang have plundered shipments, robbed merchants on the roads, and threatened local farmers.

sections.title: Deputy Willem's Justice
sections.body: Stormwind's guards are stretched thin, protecting the capital and its outer borders. So local marshals and deputies rely on volunteers to keep Northshire peaceful. Deputy Willem posts a public bounty on Garrick's head, hoping to rid the valley of his gang. Padfoot's rundown shack lies east of the river. Bringing him down there strikes at the lawlessness spreading through the human heartland.

faq.answer: Garrick Padfoot is a bandit and cutthroat in Northshire Valley. For weeks, he has harassed local farmers and ambushed merchants, gathering a small ring of thugs near the vineyards.

faq.q: Where can Garrick Padfoot be found?
faq.answer: Garrick Padfoot hides in a small wooden shack east of Northshire Abbey, across the river bridge and near the vineyards. Fellow thugs guard him.

faq.q: Who issues the bounty on Garrick?
aliases: who gives bounty on garrick padfoot
faq.answer: Deputy Willem, stationed outside Northshire Abbey, posts the bounty. With too few city guards to police the valley, he calls on wandering recruits to bring the outlaw to justice.

faq.q: Why is Stormwind not sending regular soldiers to deal with him?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched too thin. With King Varian Wrynn missing and tensions rising across Elwynn Forest and beyond, the capital cannot spare veteran garrisons for every small-time thug. Local deputies must call on recruits.
No. Garrick has gathered a small gang of outlaws and bandits who camp around his shack near the Northshire vineyards to protect him.

faq.q: What proof does Deputy Willem require?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem requires physical proof before paying the coin: bring Garrick Padfoot's severed head back to Northshire Abbey.

angles.text: Bringing down Garrick Padfoot is an early service for an aspiring Alliance adventurer, helping restore stability to the Kingdom of Stormwind.
As a human raised in the kingdom, you have reason to protect your homeland's sacred ground and local farmers from cutthroats like Padfoot.
As a rogue, you see how outlaws operate in Elwynn's shadows. A poorly hidden hideout invites a swift blade.
